text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* I knew it was coming, but still.
I'm in mega deep trouble for the upcoming Classical and Chinese lit quiz!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So relatable, for real!
What is that, code? Memorizing that is totally impawsible!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We gathered to study and all,
but seriously, I don't even have the energy to turn a textbook page~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, no, we seriously gotta do this.
Anyway, nothing happens if we don't start!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What even is "ito okashi" in the first place...
What's ito okashi? A kind of sweet?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Once this is over,
let's go to karaoke, karaoke!
I wanna eat soft-serve ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sounds good. Let's get some fries too.
Pretty sure the place in front of the station has a limited-time menu right now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no no no!
I'm just chatting away like normal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's it! That's right!
I just had a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Classic Japanese and Chinese are still languages, you know?
Maybe if we mix them into our daily chats, we can memorize them!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Palmer, verily that is
a super nice idea, y'know? â

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: This humble one is deeply impressed by Lady Palmer's thinking... Wait, isn't this Classical Japanese?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Palmer!
Super big thanks for showing me your notes the other day!
To repay you, let me totally treat you to lunch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nay, not so, not so!
Once our learning is done, together we shall venture forth!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Incredible! Palmer and Helios are true warlords indeed!
With her free-spirited imagination, Mejiro Palmer seems to have gained a whole new insight!
